phone_not_reachable_bring_it_nearby.en: Phone not reachable. Bring it nearby and try again.

open_flagship_on_your_phone_to.en: Open Flagship on your phone to see your servers here.

this_server_isnt_waiting_any_more.en: This server isn't waiting any more.

open_the_approve_page_on_this_watch.en: Open the Approve page on this watch to approve.

set_a_screen_lock_on_this_watch.en: Set a screen lock on this watch to approve from it.

put_this_watch_on_your_wrist.en: Put this watch on your wrist to approve.

watch_open_flagship_on_your_phone.ctx: watch tile headline when the watch has nothing from the phone yet (or the phone is signed out); an instruction, up to 3 short lines on a round tile

watch_open_phone_short.ctx: watch complication text when the watch has nothing from the phone yet: as short as possible (a complication shows about 7 characters); means 'open Flagship on your phone'

watch_no_servers.ctx: watch tile headline / complication text: the account has no servers yet; very short

watch_add_one_on_your_phone.en: Add one in Flagship on your phone
watch_add_one_on_your_phone.ctx: watch tile line under 'No servers': where to add a server

watch_no_servers_add_one.en: No servers yet. Add one in Flagship on your phone.
watch_no_servers_add_one.ctx: watch app, empty list when the account has no servers

watch_servers_up.ctx: watch tile headline / complication: %1$d of %2$d servers are online; very short

watch_tap_to_approve.ctx: watch tile line under 'N waiting' when several servers wait for a start-up approval

watch_leader_name.ctx: watch tile line: %1$s is the name of the leading server

watch_complication_description.ctx: watch complication's spoken description; %1$s is its short text (for example '2/3 up')

watch_phase_short_booting.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase, one short word

watch_phase_short_partitioning.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (partitioning the disk), one short word

watch_phase_short_installing.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (installing), one short word

watch_phase_short_downloading.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (downloading), one short word

watch_phase_short_registering.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (registering with Flagship), one short word

watch_phase_short_sealing.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (sealing the disk key), one short word

watch_phase_short_installed.ctx: watch tile/complication: install finished, unplug the USB stick; one short word

watch_phase_short_pairing.ctx: watch tile/complication: install phase (pairing with the phone), one short word

watch_phase_short_live.ctx: watch tile/complication: the server is live, one short word

watch_phase_short_error.ctx: watch tile/complication: the install hit a problem, one short word

watch_phase_short_other.ctx: watch tile/complication: an install step without its own name, one short word

watch_phase_other.ctx: watch app: an install step without its own title
